title: [The Skinstainery]
description: Splotches of ink and scraps of parchment sketches cover the warped wooden planks of a small parlor with a driftwood worktable in the center.  To one side, the shelves of a repurposed bookshelf are crowded with jars of pigment, stained cloths, and needles, while a hatch-marked partition has iron hooks from which hang a slew of leather aprons.  A folding chair sits next to a dented metal bucket in the work area lit by a sooty brass lantern swaying overhead.
